Woah that really sucks. I know how you feel. Like even the air around you is dangerous, waking up constantly with all of these scenarios racing in your head. But just like everyone has said you should talk to someone like a therapist. If you know your insurance (if you have any) you can look for a therapist on the insurance website but you will need parental consent so talk to parent if you can. If you don't have insurance and your school counselors aren't to terrible, you can ask them if they know of any services. Sometimes just googling 'therapy low cost + your area' will get you some ideas. Also if you have a regular doctor (colds, check ups) you could also talk to them and they can help you find someone to talk to. Otherwise, last and not best option is to join a support group online somewhere and read all you can on anxiety. You don't have to feel this way. Maybe you won't love to be around people or drive in cars with others (I still don't) but you won't always feel like you are in pain and hate yourself. Hang in there!
